The 2015 elements are drafted as structured data-element blocks in section 11.1.

head.prose:
Proposed core and optional data elements with definitions: the core data elements for a health workforce registry (CDE-HRH). CDE-HRH builds on the WHO 2015 minimum data set.

This handbook uses "core data elements" and CDE-HRH rather than "minimum data set" or MDS-HRH, because the older term has caused confusion and is not precise. The title of the WHO 2015 publication is cited as published.

The 2015 elements are drafted as structured data-element blocks in section 11.1.

base.prose:
**Key messages**

- Collect only what is needed, define it precisely, and keep it up to date.
- The minimum data set is a floor, not a ceiling. Countries can extend it.
- International classifications allow comparison across institutions and countries.
- A well-designed registry can produce many NHWA indicators as a by-product of routine operation.
